eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Fremont, WY; at 3:24 PM on AUG 9, 2026 Effective until 11:24 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: FIRE ALERT Residents from Johnny Lees Corner east through the entire Twin Creek drainage area off Highway 28 are being placed in SET status due to a rapidly moving wildfire. Residents in the affected area should be prepared to evacuate immediately if conditions worsen or a GO order is issued. Go to Fremont County Wyoming Facebook page for updates. Monitor County 10 News web page for updates
